stock.description: Lever Style Corporation, an investment holding company, engages in the design and provision of supply chain solutions in multiple apparel categories in the United States, Europe, Oceania, Canada, Greater China, and internationally. Its products include denim, knit, leather, outerwear, bottoms, shirts, soft wovens, suits, sweaters, and intimates. The company was founded in 1956 and is based in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong. Lever Style Corporation is a subsidiary of LFX Growth Capital Limited.
